definitions.gloss: group message card; collection of messages from many people
definitions.explanation: A card, sheet of {色紙|しきし} (stiff square paper) or flag on which many people each write a short message, given to someone who is leaving, graduating, retiring or in hospital.

examples.japanese: {寄|よ}せ{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote on the group card.

examples.japanese: ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寄|よ}せ{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ろう→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's make a group message card from the whole class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寄|よ}せ{書|が}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色紙|しきし}→色紙：14765_shikishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone in the department gave the retiring colleague a signed message board.

notes:
From ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to bring together) + ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄|よ}せ{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in a group card
- {寄|よ}せ{書|が}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色紙|しきし}→色紙：14765_shikishi⟧: a signed message board
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄|よ}せ{書|が}き: a graduation message card

CULTURAL NOTE:
A farewell or graduation in Japan almost always comes with one. Sports fans also write {寄|よ}せ{書|が}き on a national flag for a team or athlete.
